content.intro: In this lesson, you will study break, continue, and labeled statements with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you make program paths and repetition predictable with explicit conditions and stopping rules. In this lesson, focus on exiting loops and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Control flow decides which statements run and how often. Make conditions precise, set clear loop termination conditions, and test zero/one/many-item boundaries to catch off-by-one errors. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.
